info.title: CODShield API
info.description:
Check a cash-on-delivery customer's risk before shipping, and report delivery outcomes afterwards (Pakistan and UAE).

Authentication: system integrations send `X-API-Key` (scopes check / report / read; `cs_test_` keys run in a sandbox). People sign in with `POST /v1/auth/login` and send the session token as `Authorization: Bearer`. Platform operators use `X-Admin-Key`. Store admins create API keys in the web app (Developers) or with `POST /v1/api-keys`.

Errors share one shape: branch on `error.code`. Batches: up to 500 checks or 1,000 outcomes per call; rows fail one by one. Retrying an outcome is safe (stored once per store, order_ref and type).

Guide and data dictionary: /developers

code.description: Stable machine-readable code. Handling: unauthenticated / invalid_api_key / session_expired -> fix credentials or sign in again, don't retry; missing_scope / tier_not_allowed / country_not_enabled / forbidden / platform_only -> use a key or user with that access, don't retry; validation_failed -> fix error.fields, don't retry unchanged; quota_exceeded -> upgrade the plan, retry next month; batch_too_large -> split the batch; rate_limited -> wait Retry-After seconds then retry; service_unavailable / server_error -> retry with backoff; not_found / conflict -> check the ID or use the existing record.
